translation.name: Dillꞌ wen dillꞌ   Kob C̱he   Jesucrístonaꞌ

content: Daan, chiyaḻ' c̱hooṉlall'le yog'ḻoḻ dii mal, yog'ḻoḻ de wxiye', na' yeḻ' xe', na' yeḻ' chbell chṉe c̱he beṉ'.
Ka chon to bdo' cheeṉdo' chdom' nillaa, kan' chiyaḻ' ibiḻ idonle cho'a xtill' Chioza' daa nak dowalj, kwenc̱he gaklenan le' gonḻilall'chlene' na' idoḻ'le yeḻ' mbanna' daa goṉe'.
Ḻa' ba bnix̱ blliatele ka beṉ' wen nak X̱anchona'.
Ḻi ibig' lao X̱ancho Crístona', beena' nap yeḻ' mban, beena' zaklebi yaja' daa bi wyoolallii wen yooka', ḻa'kzi lao Chioza' nake' to beṉ' zakii nlleb na' wleje'ne' kwenc̱he gone' ka chazlallee.

Na' ḻekzka' le', Chioza' ba beṉe' to yeḻ' mban kob c̱hele daa nonḻilall'le Crístona', na' zaklebile ka yajka' daa chkwaagake' ljwellin kwenc̱he gakan to yoo ga sho' Chioza' balaaṉ. Na' gakle bx̱oz c̱he', na' Jesucrístona' gaklene' le' kwenc̱he soale we'la'ole Chioza' ka chazlallee.
Cho'a xtill' Chioza' nan:

content.text: na' zaklebile' yaja' daa mbejlawin dii wlejgakile' kwenc̱he gakan yaja' daa wc̱hejcha yoona'.
Na' beena' wx̱enilalleene', biga si'e yeḻ' zto'.

content: Ka le' ba nonḻilall'le beena' zaklebi yaja', chakbe'ile nake' beṉ' zakii. San beṉ'ka' bi nonḻilall'gake'ne' chongake' ka chillini Cho'a Xtill' Chioza' daa na:

content.text: Yaja' daa bi wyoolall' wen yooka',
ḻeyeṉ'lannan' yaja' daa ba nc̱hejcha yoona'.

content: Na' ḻekzka' nan:

content.text: Zaklebile' to yaj dii chgoo chc̱hew' beṉ' na' chchix̱an ḻegake'.

content: Chbix̱gake' daa bi chzenaggake' cho'a xtill' Chioza', na' ka'kzan chiyaḻ' gak c̱hegake'.

San le', nakle beṉ' wlej Chioza' kwenc̱he gonḻilall'lene', na' nakle bx̱oz c̱he beena' chṉabia', na' yell c̱he', to yell dii biya'o bizi'e. Na' wleje' le' kwenc̱he we'le dill' ka nak yeḻ' wak choo yeḻ' wak xen c̱he beena' bibej le' gana' nak shgasj shc̱hoḻ kwenc̱he biyoole lo beeni' choo beeni' xen c̱he'na'.
Kana', bi gokle lall' na' Chioza', san ṉaa ba nakle lall' nee. Kana', bi biyesh'lallii Chioza' le', san ṉaa ba chiyesh'lallile' le'.
Le' beṉ' bish'dawaa na' le' beṉ' zandawaa, daa nakle ka beṉ' zit' yell-lioni, chat'yoid' le' bi we'le latj we' cho'a xbayi beli chen c̱helena' daa cheeni iṉabia' yic̱hjlall'do'lena'.
Ḻi wsa' c̱hele wen ladj beṉ'ka' bi nonḻilall' Chioza', kwenc̱he llana' wc̱hoglo Chioza' c̱he to to beṉ', gakbe'gakile' benle wen na' we'la'ogake'ne', ḻa'kzi ṉaa chṉegake' c̱hele nan nakle beṉ' mal.
Daa ba nonḻilall'le X̱ancho Jesucrístona', chiyaḻ' wḻex̱j yic̱hjle lao yog'ḻoḻ beṉ'ka' chṉabia': ka lao beena' ḻiizelozi chṉabia',
na' ka'kz lao beṉ'ka' chseḻee kwenc̱he wdezi'gake' beṉ'ka' chon dii mala' na' kwee balaaṉ beṉ'ka' chon wen.
Chioza' cheenile' gonle wen kwenc̱he idap cho'a beṉ'ka' biz chon chna c̱hele, beṉ'ka' bi nteyi ni bi chajni'gakile'.
Ḻi soato ḻega beṉ' ba biyell bila', na' aga ni c̱he ba biyell bila'le na' gonle kon daa nan c̱hele. Ḻi soato ḻega beṉ' chon ka cheeni Chioza'.
Ḻi gap balaaṉ yog'ḻoḻ beṉ'. Ḻi gaki bish' ljwell-leka'. Ḻi gall illeb Chioza'. Na' ḻi gap balaaṉ beṉ' wṉabia'na'.
Ka le' chonle xshin beṉ', ḻi wḻex̱j yic̱hjle lao x̱anleka' do yic̱hj do lall'le. Aga to beṉ'ka' chonzi le' wen gonile ka', san ka'kzə ḻi goni beṉ'ka' chsak'zi' le'.
Ḻa' wenan no gon banez kat' no chsak'zi' ḻe' ḻa'kzi bibi doḻ' nape' daa ba ngoo yic̱hje' daa cheeni Chioza'.
Per shi le' chzak'zi'le ni c̱he to dii mal dii benle, bibi zakiin lao Chioza' gonlen banez. San shi chzak'zi'le ni c̱he dii wenna' chonle na' chonlen banez, ḻennan' zakii lao Chioza'.
Kwenc̱he gonle dgan gox wṉab Chioza' le'. Ḻa' Crístona' wxak'zi'e ni c̱hele na' bliile' le' nakan chiyaḻ' gonle.
Aga bi saaxya ben Crístona', ni bibi dill' wxiye' bi'e.
Kana' biz ben wnagake' c̱he', bi biyec̱hj bibi'e, na' ka bsak'zi'gake'ne' bi bwall bshebe' ḻegake', san ben kwine' lall' na' Chioza', beena' chc̱hoglo c̱he beṉ' ka chiyaḻ'.
Crístona' biyoni c̱he' saaxya c̱hechoka' ka wite' ḻee yag cruza' kwenc̱he bich goncho txen saaxyana', san soacho goncho ka cheeni Chioza'. Na' daa wxak'zi'en, zoale shi'a shao'.
Kani'yi wdale ka xil'do' ba wnit. Per ṉaa ba nakle lall' na' Crístona', beena' chap chwia le' ka beṉ' chap chwia xil' c̱heyin, na' zie' wṉeyi c̱hele.
